title: ARSIA Audit Record
description: Immutable, append-only audit record produced for every compliance-relevant event processed by an ARSIA agent. Defined in ARSIA-State.md §7.1. Audit records link a protocol event to the originating message, the participating agents, the compliance profile, and the human oversight status, enabling regulators and auditors to reconstruct the full lifecycle of any regulated interaction. The record stores a SHA-256 hash of the canonicalized payload (not the raw payload), so audit records do not contain personal data and are exempt from GDPR Art. 17 erasure.

allOf.description: Unique identifier for this audit record (UUID v4). Generated by the agent that creates the record. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.
The id field of the ARSIA message that this record documents (UUID v4). Links the audit record to the originating message. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

event_type.description: The type of event being audited. Values correspond to protocol operations: request/response/event/error/pending_approval/approval_decision are envelope intents; approval_expired is an oversight deadline expiry (ARSIA-Actions.md §3.4); state_set/state_delete/state_grant/state_revoke/state_purge are State operations (ARSIA-State.md §3); asset_transfer is an Assets operation (ARSIA-Assets.md §3); broker_relay is a Compliance Broker relay (ARSIA-Routing.md §7.4); key_rotation is an Identity key lifecycle event (ARSIA-Identity.md §2.4, §2.5); rollback is an action rollback (ARSIA-Actions.md §4.2); dora_incident is a DORA incident record (ARSIA-Assets.md §6.2.3). Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

from_agent.description: The agent-id of the message sender. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

to_agent.description: The agent-id of the message recipient. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

intent.description: The intent field from the originating message (ARSIA-Core.md §4.1). Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

payload_type.description: The payload.type field from the originating message. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

allOf.description: SHA-256 hash (lowercase hex) of the payload from the originating message. When security.encrypted is false or absent: SHA-256(RFC8785(payload)). When security.encrypted is true: SHA-256(UTF-8(JWE string)). Verifiable without decryption keys. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1 and ARSIA-Core.md §5.3.1.

SHA-256 hash (lowercase hex) of the RFC 8785 canonicalized plaintext payload. Present ONLY when the originating message has security.encrypted=true. Enables dispute resolution over encrypted content. MUST NOT be present when security.encrypted is false or absent. See ARSIA-Core.md §5.3.1.

compliance_profile.description: The compliance profile name from the message's compliance.profile field, or 'none' if the message had no compliance field. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

human_oversight_status.description: Status of human oversight for this event. 'not_required': oversight was not triggered; 'pending': event is awaiting human approval; 'approved': a human approved the action; 'denied': a human denied the action; 'expired': the approval deadline passed without a decision. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

approver_id.description: The agent-id of the agent that issued the approval_decision, when human_oversight_status is 'approved' or 'denied'. Provides accountability for oversight decisions. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

allOf.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with millisecond precision and UTC designator, indicating when this event was processed and the audit record created. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

RFC 3339 timestamp with millisecond precision and UTC designator. The date until which this audit record MUST be retained, computed as processed_at + effective retention_days from the applicable compliance profile. After this date, the record MAY be archived or deleted subject to §7.3 archival rules. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or supranational identifier (e.g. 'EU') for the geographic zone where this audit record is stored. When present, MUST match the originating message's compliance.data_residency value. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

operator_id.description: The owner_id from the IdentityRecord (ARSIA-Identity.md §1.2) of the agent that owns this audit log. Establishes legal accountability for the audit record. The identity layer is jurisdiction-agnostic, so this MAY be a VAT number, LEI URN, DUNS URN, or any national company registration number. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

allOf.description: SHA-256 of previous record's record_id concatenated with payload_hash. Tamper detection. OPTIONAL in v1.0. ARSIA-State.md §7.2.

sub_type.description: Escrow sub-type. Present when event_type is 'asset_transfer' and the event relates to an escrow lifecycle transition. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.

payment_reference.description: Payment reference from the originating AssetTransferRequest. Present in escrow audit records for traceability. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.

amount.description: The escrowed or transferred amount. Present in escrow_created audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.1.

currency_or_unit.description: Currency code or unit identifier from the transfer. Present in escrow_created audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.1.

release_agent.description: Agent-id of the authorised escrow release agent. Present in escrow_created audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.1.

allOf.description: Escrow deadline timestamp. Present in escrow_created and escrow_returned audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.1, §4.3.3.

released_by.description: Agent-id of the agent that triggered the escrow release. Present in escrow_released audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.2.

release_trigger.description: The payload.type of the release message that triggered escrow release. Present in escrow_released audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.2.

allOf.description: UUID v4 referencing the audit_id from the escrow creation record. Links subsequent escrow events to the originating escrow. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.2–§4.3.4.
Actual time the escrow timeout was processed. Present in escrow_returned audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.3.

disputed_by.description: Agent-id of the party that raised the escrow dispute. Present in escrow_disputed audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.4.

dispute_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the escrow dispute. Present in escrow_disputed audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.4.

arbitration_agent.description: Agent-id of the arbitration agent assigned to resolve the escrow dispute. Present in escrow_disputed audit records. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.4.

risk_level.description: Risk level from the ActionDescriptor for the requested action. Present in oversight audit records for the original request. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5 Record 1.

allOf.description: UUID v4 linking oversight audit records to the originating request or pending_approval message. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5 Records 2–4.
Approval deadline timestamp from the pending_approval message. Present when event_type is 'pending_approval'. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5 Record 2.

reason.description: Reason field. Present when event_type is 'approval_decision' (ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5 Record 3) or 'state_purge' (ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2).

key.description: State entry key. Present in state_set, state_delete, and state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3, §3.2.2.

owner_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the state entry owner. Present in state_set, state_delete, and state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3, §3.2.2.

actor_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the agent that performed the operation. May differ from owner_agent_id when operating via a grant. Present in state_set and state_delete audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3.

initiator_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the agent that initiated the purge operation. Present in state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2.

version.description: State entry version after the operation. Present in state_set and state_delete audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3.

pii_classification.description: GDPR classification of the state entry data. Present in state_set and state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.2.2.

pii_special_categories.description: GDPR Art. 9(1) special category types. Present in state_set audit records when pii_classification is 'sensitive'. Per ARSIA-State.md §2.1.11.

legal_basis.description: GDPR legal basis from the message's compliance.legal_basis field. Art. 6(1) grounds for 'personal' entries, Art. 9(2) grounds for 'sensitive' entries. Present in state_set audit records when pii_classification is 'personal' or 'sensitive'. Per ARSIA-State.md §8.3 Rule 3.

allOf.description: Event time — when the operation occurred at the origin. Distinct from processed_at (ingestion time). Present in state_set, state_delete, state_grant, and state_revoke audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3, §3.3.1, §3.3.2.

Timestamp of actual data destruction. Distinct from processed_at (ingestion time) and timestamp (event time). Has autonomous legal significance for GDPR Art. 5(2) accountability. Present in state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2.
UUID identifier of the access grant. Present in state_grant and state_revoke audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1, §3.3.2.

key_pattern.description: Key or key prefix pattern for the grant. Present in state_grant audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1.

grantor_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the agent granting access. Present in state_grant and state_revoke audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1, §3.3.2.

grantee_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the agent receiving access. Present in state_grant and state_revoke audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1, §3.3.2.

access_level.description: Access level of the grant. Present in state_grant audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1.

valid_until.description: Grant expiry timestamp or null for no expiry. Present in state_grant audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1.
